scope: Chengdu public-space visitor information review. People’s Park and Kuanzhai Alleys were assessed using secondary sources; no primary source was found confirming current admission, reservation, opening hours, or passport procedures. Claims are intentionally not elevated to official verification.

records.name: People’s Park
notes: Secondary sources report free general admission, but the project leaves price null because primary-source confirmation is missing.
Opening hours differ among references and are not promoted to a verified field.
Metro Line 2 / People’s Park Station is a commonly listed access point; exact gate/address remains approximate.
Teahouses and optional services may charge independently.

records.name: Kuanzhai Alleys
notes: Secondary sources describe free public lanes, but reservation claims conflict.
Some sources say 24-hour access/no reservation; others claim a real-name booking system. Neither was confirmed by a primary source.
Price and bookingRequired remain null; openingHours remains null.
Address is retained as a locator only; exact entrance and passport rules are unverified.
